recorded.how: The 400 answers and the failed job are what Builder sent the browser in the multi-user real-Builder e2e (scripts/run-real-e2e.mjs: OIDC, keys with each request, replay fixtures), and e2e/real-multi-user.spec.ts compares each run's answers with them. The 403 answers are the bodies BuilderService gave a signed-in user without a stored key under KPUBDATA_BUILDER_REQUIRE_OWN_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL=true, called in process: no e2e starts that deployment.
